name: multipliers-clamped-high
description: A 20 cm pot in low light wants 2.133 of the catalogue interval; the clamp holds it to 1.6 and the clipped part moves into the amount: 1.6 / 2.133 = 0.75 of the water each time.
why: A pot held back at the top gets a smaller amount. 20 / 15 = 1.3333 (pot size, 02i), light low 1.6 (02i), plastic 1.0: product 2.1333, factor 1.6, amount 1.6 / 2.1333 = 0.75. Hand computation, rounded to 3 decimals in the output.
